title: To Christ Th' Anointed King
description: To Christ Th' Anointed King in Tonic Solfa to SOUTHWELL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 1 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book III, prepared for the Lord's Supper, hymn 44, headed “S. M”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to SOUTHWELL; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: To Christ th'a-noint-ed King Be end-less bless-ings given, Let the whole earth his glo-ry sing Who made our peace with heaven.

lines: Let the whole earth his glory sing
Who made our peace with heaven.

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to SOUTHWELL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
